verdict.rationale: Convex's docs call it an open source database, and the self-hosting docs say the open-source backend contains the same up-to-date code as the cloud service. A public GitHub repo (get-convex/convex-backend) exists, so the source is readable. Missing for 10: the specific license is not named in the evidence, and there is no independent corroboration that the license terms are permissive or OSI-approved.
